##: Template. The authoritative manifest for a given release is attached to that release as safepaste.json, with the real archive hash; this copy carries a placeholder because the archive does not exist until the release is built.
description: Clipboard secret-guard. Detects credentials the moment they are copied and redacts them before they can be pasted.
notes: SafePaste is installed but not yet running.
It places a shield icon in the notification area and binds Ctrl+Alt+V to
sanitise the clipboard on demand. To run it at login, add a shortcut to
safepaste-daemon.exe in your Startup folder (Win+R, shell:startup).
The CLI works without the daemon:
safepaste scan -      reads stdin, exits 1 if it finds a secret
safepaste redact -    writes the sanitised text to stdout
is supported on Windows: see the [policy] section in the README.
The executables are unsigned, so SmartScreen may warn on first run.
